name: ClickHouse Loom
tagline: Self-hosted memory, document search and a code index for coding agents
description: A self-hosted MCP server on ClickHouse. Agents save and search memories shared across sessions and tools, search documents, and query a code index of your repositories (definitions, callers, impact). Memories about code stay linked to the code they name as it moves or changes. Runs on your machine with Docker Compose: install it first with the steps in https://github.com/ClickHouse/loom/blob/main/llms-install.md, then add this entry.
